title.narrative: Number of legislative amendments concerning hate crime/hate speech crime in Turkey

description.narrative: Turkish Panel Code Clause No.122 is the regulation of Hate and Discrimination. This law has certain deficiencies. We will prepare a legislative proposal and conduct advocacy activities to improve the regulation. The indicator will be used for monitoring the legislative amendment. The previous wording of the indicator was Number of laws concerning hate crime/hate speech crime in Turkey which was inappropriate, since there is a law concerning hate crimes. Therefore, we renamed the indicator to the current version.

comment.narrative: We will carry out advocacy activities to improve legislation around hate speech and hate crimes. Istanbul Bar Association published a press release pointing out to the deficiencies in Turkish Panel Code Clause No.122. It briefly indicates that the concept hate is too abstract and subjective to be used as a measure for relating to a criminal offence. This situation causes discriminatory activities impossible for the victims to prove and for the law to process objectively. The result is impunity for hate and discrimination. Therefore we will conduct further research get legal counseling and prepare a legislative proposal to advocate. If we succeed to get the legislation amended it will count as a structural impact.
